reasoning: The native ambiguity crops show source-supported magenta left-triangle and olive right-triangle CO2 marker glyphs in the crowded low-pressure region that were not represented by Python point rows. I added one supported marker of each series in each of ambiguity crops 001-007, using broad uncertainties because the glyphs are overlapped. Crops 008-011 confirm the black CO2 273K square sequence without a supported positional correction. Crops 012-014 show black N2 313K triangles in the low band rather than omitted CO2 markers, so no CO2 additions are made there. The CO2 313K and 323K series remain incomplete because this batch does not expose enough unambiguous native marker centers to recover all of the reported shortfall.
